Enum AuraFormatType

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

The type of format to use for data serialization or vertex attributes. Formats starting with 'N' mean Normalized (values are scaled between 0.0f-1.0f or -1.0f-1.0f within the entire bit length min/max). Formats starting with 'U' mean Unsigned (only positive numbers, e.g., 0 to Max). Formats starting with 'S' mean Signed (allow negative numbers, e.g., Min to Max).
